name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg-cfg-wact2-spine-COMMIT
purpose: H2 uses registered physical bank onehots for both oldest-write ACT and current queue PRE exclusion, removing remaining1669-load rotated rp network with no normal edges/extra state; full same-cycle policy and full service proof retained. Replace measured H1 TritonCTS97.7ps spread with supported explicit equal-delay balanced clock spine, including each real SRAM clock as its own leaf, preserving all timing constraints/ports/outline. Clock delay/area and setup require fresh measurement; H1 is unqualified at setup-122.9ps.
